title: angelica angelicifolia
intro: Angelica angelicifolia, commonly known as Rocky Mountain angelica, is a perennial plant in the carrot family that is native to the western regions of North America. It has been traditionally used in herbal medicine for its various health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties that can help to reduce pain, alleviate digestive issues, and boost the immune system. The therapeutic actions of Angelica angelicifolia include its ability to stimulate digestion, relieve respiratory issues, and act as a diuretic. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpenes, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
